extractions.description: This paper proposes Multi-Objective GFlowNets (MOGFNs), a method for generating diverse Pareto optimal candidates in multi-objective optimization problems. It focuses on applications like drug discovery and material design where diverse solutions need to be generated for potentially conflicting objectives. The paper introduces two variants of MOGFNs: Preference-Conditional and Active Learning Loop, demonstrating advantages in Pareto performance and candidate diversity in various tasks like molecule and biological sequence generation.
